exposure: Maternal folic acid supplementation (5 mg daily from pro-oestrous through day 40 of gestation)
cohort: The study included Labrador retrievers, golden retrievers, and Labrador/golden Crosses from the breeding colony of a professional guide dog training organisation.
finding: Maternal folic acid supplementation (5 mg) was not associated with a reduction in cleft palates, umbilical hernias, stillbirths, or caesarean sections in the guide dog breeding colony.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were an outcome measured in the study, and folic acid supplementation did not detectably reduce their incidence rate.
